Title: Platform Terms of Use
en_Text:
MySeattleSearch.com provides neighborhood intelligence, historical real property survey records, municipal infrastructure data, transit monitors, and real estate market analysis. When you browse this site or install our client progressive web app, you agree to these ground rules.
Informational Purpose Only: While we aggregate property rolls, utility networks, and municipal tax data directly from official county sources and regional APIs, all information on this site is provided for general guidance and advisory research. Property boundaries, school service zones, tax assessments, and transit feeds can shift through local legislative action. Real estate decisions should always be verified against direct municipal records, preliminary title reports, and licensed physical inspections. We are not a replacement for the Emergency Alert System or 911.
No Automated Scraping: We engineer high-performance edge infrastructure to deliver sub-second data to our human users. We strictly prohibit automated scraping, high-frequency bot harvesting, and unauthorized replication of our proprietary databases, historical photo repositories, and neighborhood analytical models.

Title: Privacy & Telemetry Policy
en_Text:
We believe personal privacy is a fundamental standard, not an afterthought. Our platform architecture is built from the ground up to minimize data collection:
Zero Tracking Cookies: We do not set third-party marketing cookies, track your browsing behavior across other websites, or embed invasive social media monitoring pixels. Because of this, you will never be bothered by a pop-up cookie consent banner on our site.
No Data Brokering: We never sell, lease, monetize, or trade your contact details, search patterns, or dossier data to third-party marketing firms, mortgage lead aggregators, or advertising networks.
Cryptographic Client Portals: When you access a private property portal, your session is verified using a unique cryptographic token stored exclusively within your local browser or installed app. We do not use passwords that can be breached or compromised.
Lock-Screen Push Notifications: Web alerts are delivered using encrypted standard protocols directly to your device. You maintain complete control over alert toggles inside your portal settings and can revoke permissions at any time.
For any questions regarding how your data is handled, email us directly at help@myseattlesearch.com.

Title: Wire Fraud Warning & Protection Advisory
en_Text:
Urgent Consumer Safeguard: Never Wire Funds Based on Email Instructions Alone.
Criminals actively target real estate transactions by hacking email accounts, creating convincing lookalike addresses, and sending fraudulent wire instructions right before closing. We will never email you updated wire routing numbers or request that you change wiring instructions mid-transaction.
Stop Before Sending: Do not rely on incoming phone numbers, email signatures, or attachments received via email for wire destinations.
Voice-Verify Independently: Call your closing escrow officer using a verified phone number from your original opening documentation before sending any funds.

Title: DMCA Copyright Agent Notice
en_Text:
We curate historical photography and architectural records primarily from public domain archives, including the King County 1937 WPA Real Property survey, the Washington State Digital Archives, and the Puget Sound Regional Archives.
If you believe material hosted on our platform infringes upon an active copyright you hold, please send a written takedown notice to our designated agent. Your notice must include identification of the copyrighted work, the exact web address (URL) of the material, your contact credentials, a statement of good faith belief, and your signature.
Designated DMCA Agent: Compliance & Intellectual Property Desk, MySeattleSearch.com, Email: help@myseattlesearch.com.

Title: Brokerage Representation, Fair Housing & Accessibility
en_Text:
Real Estate Licensing & Brokerage: Real estate brokerage services on this site are conducted under Washington State real estate licensing laws. Property listings sourced from the Northwest Multiple Listing Service (NWMLS) are subject to prior sale, change, or cancellation. All property dimensions, square footages, and boundary outlines are approximate.
Equal Housing Opportunity: We are committed to the letter and spirit of U.S. and Washington State fair housing policies. We conduct all business in strict compliance with the federal Fair Housing Act and the Washington Law Against Discrimination (RCW 49.60). We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, sex, familial status, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.
Digital Accessibility (ADA Compliance): We strive to provide an equitable digital experience for all users, designing to meet or exceed Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1 Level AA). If you encounter any accessibility barrier or have difficulty reading any part of this site with assistive technology, please contact us at help@myseattlesearch.com. We will provide the requested data through an alternate accessible medium.
